svg.title: Shoga-Speaks
svg.desc: One Claude Code task, why is the orders page slow, starts as a dense knot of thread covered in technical words. Shoga, a green parrot, catches the loose end and pulls it into one straight line. The jargon falls into a Technical tag and a plain two-line story rises from the line, told three times for three readers: a developer in Roman-Urdu, a QA tester in Dutch and a product owner in English. The tag then opens into a card with the same details put in order, and one term gets a plain explanation. The line finally becomes the underline of Shoga-Speaks, where Shoga lands: seedhi baat, no bakwas.
